name: portask
description: Portask monorepo — Express API + React frontend

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix api" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix api && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix api && npm run test --prefix frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix api && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
